# Objective

Fit Ridge, Lasso, and Elastic Net to a synthetic time-ordered regression with correlated predictors and compare holdout error.

# Run

```bash
python python/qm019_regularized_models.py
```

# Experiment

Change the predictor correlation and the penalty strengths. Inspect whether prediction error and coefficient stability move together.

The data are synthetic. The lab makes no empirical market-performance claim.
